title: Temporary 4-day workweek for 30 Lapu-Lapu City Hall offices

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu – The Lapu-Lapu City Government has implemented a temporary four-day workweek in 30 selected city government offices since Monday last week, October 26, to conserve fuel and energy amid rising fuel prices and power supply constraints. Under Executive Order No. 2026-74, selected offices will operate from 7:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Monday to Thursday, with a 30-minute lunch break. Mayor Cynthia “Cindi” King-Chan issued it last October 20. The city government advised the public to take note of the adjusted office schedules when planning transactions with the city.
